verdict.rationale: Pricing and rate limits are a fair question for a hosted MCP connection platform like Smithery, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents per-tool-call or per-connection pricing, or any published rate limits. The cited docs cover OAuth handling, token scoping, Uplink, publishing and triggers, none of which address cost or throttling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
